newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, gains for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, gains for blue chips.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly mixed in lively trade on Friday with gains for blue chips and losses among some hoteliers.
* Of 11 active stocks five rose, four fell and two were flat.
* Volume higher at 22,530 units, turnover tripled to 18.3 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer chocolate maker Kras rose 25 kuna to 475, on volume of 866 shares.
*Biggest decliner hotelier Istraturist lost 38 kuna to 190, on volume of 824 shares.
* Most active issue food processor Podravka held its ground at 320 kuna, selling 8,668 shares.
